report.summary: Based on the hypothesis and the absence of user insights and comments, it is unclear whether the target audience is willing to discuss security issues in professional channels. The market and competitors suggest a need for data leak prevention tools, but the hypothesis relies on the assumption that security specialists and IT executives are willing to participate in an anonymous survey. Given the lack of evidence, it is recommended to collect user insights and comments to validate the hypothesis.
recommendations: Conduct user interviews with 5-10 security specialists and IT executives to validate the hypothesis and gather insights on their willingness to participate in an anonymous survey.
Create a landing page or fake-door to measure interest in the survey and gather additional insights on the target audience.

Post in professional communities (LinkedIn InfoSec groups, Telegram channels for CISO, SecurityStack forums, and Reddit r/cybersecurity) to gather comments and feedback on the survey and gather additional insights on the target audience.
